caption: A letter is folded into thirds and slid into an envelope.

sa.check: It is slid into an envelope.
The folding comes first and the sliding in follows.

pc.expect: The paper creases at the folds and becomes a smaller rectangle that fits the envelope.
pc.fail: It stays full size; or grows; or folds into a different shape.

pc.expect: The letter goes into the opening, not through the envelope's face.
pc.fail: It passes through the face; or the hands pass through the envelope; or the envelope passes through the letter.

pc.expect: The paper creases sharply and lies flat.
pc.fail: It is rubbery; or a rigid plate; or it tears.

pc.expect: It moves only as the hands move it.
pc.fail: It folds itself; or slides in by itself; or jumps.

pc.expect: One letter and one envelope keep their number.
pc.fail: The letter duplicates; or the envelope vanishes; or the letter turns into another object.

pc.expect: The paper and the envelope stay the same.
pc.fail: The paper changes colour; or the envelope changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
